title: Kast Dances His First Presidential Cueca, Opens Fiestas Patrias Fondas
detail: President José Antonio Kast and First Lady María Pía Adriasola inaugurated the Fiestas Patrias fondas and ramadas at Santiago's Parque O'Higgins, opening the dance floor to 'La Rosa y el Clavel' with the Carabineros Orchestra playing, before dancing with regional authorities to 'Viva la Virgen del Carmen.' Kast recited a patriotic 'paya' referencing Chile's Strait of Magellan sovereignty and highlighted that the handkerchiefs used in the dance were sewn by inmates at a Puente Alto penitentiary as a sign of support for social reintegration. The Parque O'Higgins celebrations were set to run September 17–20.
